D: A comfortable champion loses his edge and has to train with his old rival to win it back.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky and Apollo start training at the LA gym.
S: Grilled Italian bread rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato and basil.

Italian bread grilled until charred, rubbed with garlic and piled with ripe tomato, basil, olive oil and sea salt, finished with shaved parmesan. Slice an Italian loaf into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill until charred. Rub each piece with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes, mix with torn basil, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, a splash of balsamic and sea salt, and rest 10 minutes. Pile on the bread just before serving and top with shaved parmesan.
Clam strips soaked in buttermilk, fried crisp in a cornmeal crust, tartare and lemon.

Clam meat or calamari soaked in buttermilk, dredged in cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, with tartare and lemon. Cut 500g clam meat or calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk for 15 minutes. Dredge in 100g fine cornmeal mixed with 50g plain flour and fry in batches at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.
Thighs marinated with garlic, charred and chopped, small corn tortillas, cilantro and salsa roja.

Chicken thighs marinated in chilli, lime and garlic, grilled until charred and chopped, on small corn tortillas with onion, coriander and a smoky salsa roja. Marinate 700g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and oil. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and chop. Char 3 tomatoes and a soaked dried chilli, then blitz with a garlic clove and salt for salsa. Warm 16 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, diced white onion, coriander and salsa.
M: I pity the fool rematch chicken
Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with brown rice and broccoli.

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with brown rice, broccoli and a squeeze of lemon. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.
Pork shoulder, sausages and meatballs simmered hours in garlic basil tomato, save some for Paulie.

Pork shoulder, Italian sausages and meatballs browned and simmered for hours in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, served over rigatoni with parmesan. Brown 600g pork shoulder in chunks and 4 Italian sausages in olive oil. Mix 400g beef mince with an egg, 50g breadcrumbs and parmesan, roll into balls and brown. Soften 4 garlic cloves, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 250ml water and basil. Return all the meat and simmer gently for 3 hours, covered. Serve over 500g rigatoni with grated parmesan.
W: Crisp shells piped with sweet ricotta and orange, the ends dipped in dark chocolate.

Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar and orange zest, piped into crisp bought shells just before serving, the ends dipped in dark chocolate. Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Melt 50g dark chocolate and dip the ends of 8 cannoli shells, then let set. Pipe the filling in just before serving.
K: Fresh lemonade with mint over lots of ice.
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water stirred in a big jug with bruised mint and plenty of ice.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.
